The generalized statistical factor B_N^{(s)}(E; a), Eq. (34).

Source: R/statfactor.R
statfactor-overview.Rd

B_N(E) is the Boltzmann factor averaged over the innermost reservoir temperature, Eq. (24): B_N(E) = int_0^inf exp(-E/T_N) f_N(T_N) dT_N.

Details

Two invariants anchor the package (checked in tests/testthat/test-statfactor.R): the flat-energy sum rule, Eq. (27), and the boundary conditions B(0) = 1, B(inf) = 0, B'(E) < 0, Eq. (7)/(43).
